## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design for multi-region, air-gapped CNFs with strict provenance and runtime security, focusing on upgrade safety without image pulls.

## Key Concepts
- Runtime attestation with TPM-backed keys (Sigstore)
- Image provenance with SBOMs and Cosign
- In-cluster drift detection via eBPF
- Policy-driven rollback (OPA/Gatekeeper)

```
apiVersion: constraints.gatekeeper.sh/v1beta1
kind: K8sImageProvenance

spec:

      kind: Deployment
  parameters:

    requireSignature: true
```

## Why This Is Asked
Assesses ability to design end-to-end supply chain security and runtime integrity for multi-cloud CNFs, including identity management, attestation mechanisms, policy-as-code enforcement, and network isolation during zero-downtime upgrades.

## Key Concepts
- SPIFFE/SPIRE identity management
- TPM/IMA runtime attestation
- SPDX SBOM delta validation
- OPA/Kyverno policy enforcement
- Cilium eBPF network policies
- Canary upgrade strategies

## Code Example
```yaml
# SPIFFE identity configuration
apiVersion: spiffe.example/v1
kind: SPIFFEIdentity
metadata:
  name: cnf-identity-01
spec:
  spiffeID: spiffe://cluster/ns/cnf-01
  parentID: spiffe://cluster/ns/workload-scheduler
  ttl: 1h
```

```yaml
# OPA upgrade gate policy
package cnf.upgrade
default allow = false

allow {
  input.attestation.trust_score >= 80
  input.sbom.delta.additions == 0
  input.network_policy.isolated == true
}
```

## Implementation Approach
The solution integrates identity, attestation, and policy enforcement to ensure upgrades maintain security posture while achieving zero downtime through controlled canary deployments.

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This tests ability to implement zero-downtime upgrades in a multi-tenant CNF gateway, focusing on per-tenant isolation, cross-namespace coordination, and robust failure handling.

## Key Concepts
- Graceful drain: per-tenant drain window, preStop, readiness gates
- Global upgrade control: ConfigMap flag
- Control-plane signaling: endpoint or event
- Failure modes: stuck drains, failed signal, burst load

## Code Example
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: cnf-upgrade
  namespace: tenant-a
data:
  upgradePause: "true"
```

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: gateway-tenant-a
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: gateway
          image: cnf/gateway:latest
          lifecycle:
            preStop:
              exec:
                command: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:9000/drain || true"]
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /ready
              port: 9000
              protocol: HTTP
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 5
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you test the drain behavior under bursty traffic?
- How would you handle tenants with long-lived streams (WebSockets)?

## Why This Is Asked
Tests practical understanding of image provenance, Cosign SBOM integration, and admission control in CNF deployments. It asks for an end-to-end flow with concrete steps and minimal config to validate in a single namespace before broader rollout.

## Key Concepts
- Cosign signing with a KMS-backed key
- SPDX SBOM generation and attachment
- ImagePolicyWebhook admission checks
- Per-tenant namespace isolation and observability

## Code Example

```yaml
# Minimal ImagePolicyWebhook-ish configuration (conceptual)

kind: ValidatingWebhookConfiguration
metadata:
  name: image-provenance
webhooks:
- name: image-provenance.example.com
  clientConfig:
    service:
      name: image-policy
      namespace: image-policy
      path: "/validate"
  rules:
  - apiGroups: ["apps"]
```

Why This Is Asked

- Rego policy referencing namespace ConfigMap values
- Per-tenant overrides via Namespace annotations/config

- Minimal YAML scaffolding for quick rollout checks

Code Example

```yaml
# ConstraintTemplate: defines RateLimitTemplate for K8sRateLimit
apiVersion: templates.gatekeeper.sh/v1beta1
kind: ConstraintTemplate
metadata:
  name: k8sratelimittemplate
spec:
  crd:
    spec:
      names:
        kind: K8sRateLimit
  targets:
  - target: admission.k8s.gatekeeper.sh
    rego: |
      package k8sratelimit
      # Pseudocode: reads per-namespace cnf.rate-limit and enforces a per-minute cap
      defaultRate := 100
      rateLimitPerMin := data.rateLimitPerMin
      # implementation would map namespace to rate and count requests
      # returns deny if burst exceeds rate
```

```yaml
# Constraint: per-tenant rate limit value
apiVersion: constraints.gatekeeper.sh/v1beta1
kind: K8sRateLimit
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-rate-limit
spec:
  match:
    kinds:
    - apiGroups: [""]
      kinds: ["Namespace"]
  parameters:
    rateLimitPerMin: 200
    targetPath: "/gateway"
```

```yaml
# Namespace manifest overriding default rate for tenant-a
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: tenant-a
  annotations:
```
